
## Data

```{r load-data}
d0_draws <- read.csv("data/results_sim3_rstan_posterior_draws_d0_rep1.csv")
d3_draws <- read.csv("data/results_sim3_rstan_posterior_draws_d3_rep1.csv")
draws_all <- rbind(d0_draws, d3_draws)

# order as factor with levels d0..d3
draws_all$order <- factor(draws_all$order, levels = c("d0", "d1", "d2", "d3"))
```

## Bridge Sampling BF (reference values)

```{r bridge-values}
bridge_vals <- data.frame(
  delta_true = c(rep(0, 16), rep(3, 16)),
  N = rep(c(20, 20, 20, 20, 50, 50, 50, 50, 100, 100, 100, 100, 200, 200, 200, 200), 2),
  order = factor(rep(c("d0","d1","d2","d3"), 8), levels = c("d0","d1","d2","d3")),
  log_bf10_bridge = c(
    # delta = 0
    -0.695, -0.593, -0.839, -0.0602,
    -1.13,  -1.17,  -1.46,  -0.962,
    -0.920, -1.64,  -1.96,  -1.94,
    -1.51,  -1.74,  -2.27,  -1.87,
    # delta = 3
     1.52,   1.64,   1.68,   1.68,
    16.2,   16.3,   16.4,   16.4,
    27.2,   27.5,   27.6,   27.5,
    54.1,   54.4,   54.4,   54.4
  )
)
```

## Compute Logspline and ECDF BFs (eps = 0.2)

```{r compute-bfs}
EPS <- 0.2

compute_bf_row <- function(draws, d_order, method) {
  bf10_interval_null_delta(
    delta_draws = draws,
    d_order     = d_order,
    eps         = EPS,
    method      = method,
    return_log  = TRUE
  )$log_bf10
}

# Compute one row per (delta_true, N, order)
bf_computed <- draws_all |>
  group_by(delta_true, N, order) |>
  summarise(
    log_bf10_logspline = compute_bf_row(
      delta_draw,
      d_order = as.integer(sub("d", "", order[1])),
      method  = "logspline"
    ),
    log_bf10_ecdf = compute_bf_row(
      delta_draw,
      d_order = as.integer(sub("d", "", order[1])),
      method  = "ecdf"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

## Result Table

```{r result-table}
result_tbl <- bridge_vals |>
  left_join(bf_computed, by = c("delta_true", "N", "order")) |>
  mutate(
    log_bf10_bridge    = round(log_bf10_bridge,    3),
    log_bf10_logspline = round(log_bf10_logspline, 3),
    log_bf10_ecdf      = round(log_bf10_ecdf,      3)
  ) |>
  rename(
    `log_bf10_raw (ecdf, eps=0.2)`      = log_bf10_ecdf,
    `log_bf10_logspline (eps=0.2)`      = log_bf10_logspline
  )

kable(
  result_tbl,
  caption = "Bayes Factor comparison: bridge sampling vs logspline vs ECDF (eps = 0.2)",
  align   = c("c","c","c","r","r","r")
)
```

## BF Comparison Plot

```{r bf-plot, fig.height=7, fig.width=11}
# Pivot the three BF columns to long format for ggplot
bf_long <- result_tbl |>
  rename(
    bridge    = log_bf10_bridge,
    logspline = `log_bf10_logspline (eps=0.2)`,
    ecdf      = `log_bf10_raw (ecdf, eps=0.2)`
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = c(bridge, logspline, ecdf),
    names_to  = "method",
    values_to = "log_bf10"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    method      = factor(method,
                         levels = c("bridge", "logspline", "ecdf"),
                         labels = c("Bridge", "Logspline (eps=0.2)", "ECDF (eps=0.2)")),
    delta_label = factor(
      ifelse(delta_true == 0, "True delta == 0", "True delta == 3"),
      levels = c("True delta == 0", "True delta == 3")
    )
  )

# Reference lines: BF = 1 (log = 0) and common evidence thresholds
thresh <- data.frame(
  yintercept = c(0, log(3), log(10), -log(3), -log(10)),
  label      = c("BF=1", "BF=3", "BF=10", "BF=1/3", "BF=1/10")
)

ggplot(bf_long, aes(x = N, y = log_bf10,
                    color = method, shape = method, linetype = method)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.4, color = "grey40") +
  geom_hline(yintercept =  log(3),  linewidth = 0.3, color = "grey60", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log(3),  linewidth = 0.3, color = "grey60", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.75) +
  geom_point(size = 2.2) +
  facet_grid(
    delta_label ~ order,
    labeller = labeller(delta_label = label_value, order = label_value),
    scales   = "free_y"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(20, 50, 100, 200)) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Bridge" = "#1b7837",
               "Logspline (eps=0.2)" = "#2166ac",
               "ECDF (eps=0.2)"      = "#d6604d")
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c("Bridge" = 16, "Logspline (eps=0.2)" = 17, "ECDF (eps=0.2)" = 15)
  ) +
  scale_linetype_manual(
    values = c("Bridge" = "solid", "Logspline (eps=0.2)" = "dashed", "ECDF (eps=0.2)" = "dotted")
  ) +
  labs(
    title    = "log BF10 by method, prior order, N, and true delta",
    subtitle = "Dashed grey lines: log(BF) = ±log(3) (moderate evidence threshold)",
    x        = "Sample size N",
    y        = "log BF10",
    color    = "Method", shape = "Method", linetype = "Method"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title     = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    plot.subtitle  = element_text(size = 10, color = "grey40"),
    strip.text     = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```

## Posterior Histograms of Delta

```{r plot-helper}
#' Plot posterior histograms of delta from raw draws
#' Mimics plot_posterior_delta() but accepts a data.frame of draws
#'
#' @param df Data.frame with columns delta_draw and order (factor)
#' @param title Plot title
#' @param xlim Optional x-axis limits
#' @param bins  Number of histogram bins
plot_posterior_delta_draws <- function(df, title = NULL, xlim = NULL, bins = 40) {
  # Overlay moment prior for each order
  x_max <- quantile(df$delta_draw, 0.995, na.rm = TRUE)
  x_seq <- seq(0, x_max, length.out = 300)

  prior_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(levels(df$order), function(ord) {
    d <- as.integer(sub("d", "", ord))
    kap <- get_kappa(d)
    data.frame(
      x     = x_seq,
      y     = prior_moment_density(x_seq, d = d, kappa = kap),
      order = factor(ord, levels = levels(df$order))
    )
  }))

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = delta_draw)) +
    geom_histogram(
      aes(y = after_stat(density)),
      bins = bins, fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.6, color = "white"
    ) +
    geom_line(
      data = prior_df, aes(x = x, y = y),
      color = "firebrick", linewidth = 0.8
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~order, ncol = 4, scales = "free_y") +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x     = expression(delta),
      y     = "Density"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title    = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
      strip.text    = element_text(face = "bold"),
      panel.grid    = element_blank(),
      panel.border  = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5)
    )

  if (!is.null(xlim))
    p <- p + coord_cartesian(xlim = xlim)

  p
}
```

### True delta = 0

```{r plots-d0, results='asis', fig.height=4}
sub_d0 <- draws_all |> filter(delta_true == 0)

for (n_val in c(20, 50, 100, 200)) {
  cat(sprintf("\n#### N = %d\n\n", n_val))
  df_sub <- sub_d0 |> filter(N == n_val)
  p <- plot_posterior_delta_draws(
    df_sub,
    title = sprintf("Posterior of delta | true delta = 0, N = %d", n_val)
  )
  print(p)
  cat("\n")
}
```

### True delta = 3

